Grace —

Appreciate the redline. Quick reactions after a first pass:

- The "fee buffer" idea seems reasonable as a concept, but we need clearer operational triggers. Our finance team won't accept an opaque smoothing window without a defined calculation they can audit. Is the 3-month trailing average what you're proposing?

- On floors: BlueNova is sensitive to anything that looks like an absolute minimum commit. We prefer a soft floor tied to trailing usage (e.g., 85% of trailing 90-day average) rather than a fixed $ amount, especially for the launch months where usage could be lumpy.

- Regarding the launch grace, a 90-day temporary suspension of the floor sounds more realistic than 30. Can your team tolerate that?

I'll loop in procurement and finance internally after I validate the calculation. I pasted the relevant snippet of your email below for context.

Todd / Alana — any redlines to the above language? If that concept lands, Marissa can produce legal-ready wording tomorrow.

Team / Todd —

I've reviewed the suggested plain-English approach and converted it to amendment text that balances commercial intent and operational safeguards. Key points:

1) Definition: "Trailing Usage" means the average daily billable tokens over the 90 days immediately preceding the billing period.

2) Soft Floor: For each monthly invoice, the floor shall be calculated as 85% of Trailing Usage multiplied by the applicable per-token rate. The floor serves solely for the purpose of establishing a minimum billing baseline and shall not be construed as a minimum purchase commitment.

3) Launch Grace: The Parties agree that for the first 90 days following Service Activation, the Soft Floor shall be suspended.

4) True-up and Cap: Monthly invoices shall include a reconciliation true-up to actual usage. No single-month invoiced charge resulting from the Soft Floor shall exceed 150% of the Trailing Usage charge; any overage beyond that cap must be escalated to contract managers for review prior to collection.

5) Auditability: Redwood will provide a usage report showing daily token counts and the calculation of Trailing Usage on request. Audit requests shall be subject to the Confidentiality provisions in the Agreement.

Operational notes for Ben / Karthik: please confirm the following before we finalize:
- The exact UTC boundary used for daily counts (end-of-day cutover)
- Whether we can produce the 90-day trail as a single downloadable CSV per invoice cycle

If Todd / Alana accept this language in principle, I will prepare a tracked-confirmation version for signatures and update the DocuSign envelope.
